learning_outcomes.text: Have systematic knowledge and understanding of the key concepts and aspects of Elasticity in real solids.
Be able to apply their knowledge and understanding to identify, formulate and solve calculation and design problems in elastic regime using specifically established methods.
Be able to choose and apply relevant analytical and modeling methods associated with elastic behavior.
Be able to apply their knowledge to develop and carry out designs in elastic regime that meet specific requirements.
Have an understanding of the different methods used in elasticity and the ability to use them.
Be able to design and conduct characterization experiments, interpret data and draw conclusions.
Have technical and laboratory competencies in elasticity.
Be able to select and use appropriate equipment, tools and methods to solve problems in elastic regime.
Be able to combine theory and practice to solve Elasticity problems.
Have an understanding of applicable methods and techniques for solving problems in elastic regime and their limitations.
A systematic understanding of the key concepts and aspects of their branch of engineering.
An adequate knowledge of their branch of engineering that includes some knowledge at the forefront of their field.
The ability to apply their knowledge and understanding to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems using established methods.
The ability to choose and apply relevant analytical and modeling methods.
The ability to apply their knowledge to develop and carry out designs that meet specific requirements.
Understanding of the different methods and the ability to use them.
The ability to design and carry out experiments, interpret data and draw conclusions.
Technical and laboratory competencies.
The ability to select and use appropriate equipment, tools and methods.
The ability to combine theory and practice to solve engineering problems.
The understanding of applicable methods and techniques and their limitations.

Students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that builds on general secondary education, and is usually found at a level that, while supported by advanced textbooks, also includes some aspects that involve knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

Students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional way and possess the competencies that are usually demonstrated by the elaboration and defense of arguments and the resolution of problems within their field of study.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Ability to design a system, component or process in the field of mechanical engineering, to meet the required specifications.
Knowledge and ability to apply computational and experimental tools for the analysis and quantification of mechanical engineering problems.
Knowledge and use of the principles of strength of materials.
Knowledge and abilities to apply the fundamentals of elasticity and strength of materials to the behavior of real solids.

syllabus_topics: Chapter 3. Methods for Solving Elasticity Equations
Topic 7: Yield Criteria: Tresca-Guest and Von Mises
Topic 8: Plane Elasticity. Plane stress and strain states.
Topic 9: Plane Elasticity in polar coordinates
Topic 10: Introduction to anisotropic elasticity and thermal actions.
teaching_methods: Two weekly teaching sessions for theoretical concepts and problem solving application
assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 4.5 out of 10 in the final exam (60%) is required for the continuous assessment (40%) to be taken into account. The continuous assessment consists of laboratory practices (15%) and continuous assessment tests (25%). Attendance and completion of the scheduled laboratory practices are compulsory to pass the course. The extraordinary call follows the university's general regulations.
